name: TP Browser
subtitle: Tonpoon's browser for iPhone and iPad
description: Install TP Browser and get its updates automatically.

apps.name: TP Browser
apps.subtitle: Fast, private, focused. With TP AI.
apps.localizedDescription: Tonpoon's own web browser: Spaces for School, Games and Personal tabs, TP Shield (blocks ads and trackers), Focus mode, reader view with read-aloud, dark mode for websites, and TP AI, a free assistant that can read pages and open sites for you. Tap 🎤 to ask out loud and it answers out loud. Updates itself.

versions.localizedDescription:
📷 Scan QR codes with Apple’s own code reader: tap the scan button in search, or ⋮ › Scan QR code. TP shows where a link goes before you open it
📶 Wi-Fi codes show the network name and password, ready to copy. Phone numbers, emails, places and PromptPay codes are recognised too
🖼️ Scan a photo: read a QR code from a screenshot or picture. (The scanner comes with the TP Browser 2.5.2 app: update it in SideStore or AltStore)
✦ TP AI is back to how it was before the last update

🧠 TP AI is smarter: it now runs on OpenAI’s open gpt-oss models (served by Groq), and thinks harder before answering maths, science, coding and puzzle questions
🔎 For news, prices, scores and anything that changes, TP AI searches the web and reads the best pages itself, then tells you which sites it used
📌 Say “remember that…” and TP AI keeps the note for future chats. See or delete what it remembers in Settings › TP AI
📊 Answers can include tables, and TP AI checks its working and says when it isn’t sure

🎮 Tonpoon Arcade: games inside TP Browser that work offline. Open it from the home page or the ⋮ menu
⛏️ TP Blocks is built in: explore a world of blocks, break and build, and fly around, with no connection needed
⬇️ Get more games like Neon Snake and Brick Bounce when you’re online. Once downloaded, they play offline too
⌨️ The address bar has a normal keyboard again, with a space bar, like Safari’s. The odd ⌃ ⌄ arrows above the keyboard are gone from TP’s own fields

📱 Built for iOS 27: TP Browser gets iOS 27’s refined Liquid Glass, and its glass address bar follows your Liquid Glass look setting
🌫️ When a page scrolls under the address bar, iOS softens it underneath so the bar stays easy to read
♿ TP’s glass turns solid with Reduce Transparency and gets clear outlines with Increase Contrast, like the rest of iPhone

🫧 Real Liquid Glass: on iOS 26 the address bar is now made of Apple’s own Liquid Glass. It bends and tints with the page behind it and ripples under your finger
📜 Websites now run all the way to the bottom of the screen and scroll underneath the floating bar, like Safari. Their own buttons stay above it
✨ TP’s messages, the 🎤 voice panel and iPhone pop-ups use Apple’s glass too
🍎 On iOS 15–18, TP keeps its glass look-alike

🫧 Liquid Glass: buttons, menus, the address bar and switches are now made of glass, like iPhone’s own apps. Press a button and it swells and glows under your finger
🎚️ Choices like Spaces and themes slide a glass lens to the one you pick
📐 With the new app version, the address bar floats over the page, menus float above the bottom edge and the page’s own colour shows around them

📱 TP Browser is on iPhone and iPad: the same home page, Spaces, TP Shield, Focus mode and TP AI as on your other devices
🗣️ Tap 🎤 to ask TP AI out loud and it answers out loud. Type and it stays quiet
🔄 Updates itself: new versions of TP’s screens download in the background and finish when you tap Restart & update

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scans QR codes when you tap Scan QR code, and lets websites you allow use your camera.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Websites you allow can see your location.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lets you talk to TP AI and search instead of typing, and lets websites you allow use the microphone.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Saves screenshots of pages to your Photos.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turns what you say into text when you tap 🎤 in search or TP AI.
